Question Choices: Is every rhombus a square? Answer yes or no
Hints: A square must have four right angles.
Solution: no|No. While a rhombus has four equal sides, it does not always have four right angles, so it cannot always be a square.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has all sides the same length and opposite sides parallel, but its angles are not right angles. What is it called? : Rectangle Square Rhombus Trapezoid
Hints: All sides of a square are also equal, but a square must have right angles.
Solution: Rhombus. A rhombus is a parallelogram where all four sides are equal, even if the angles are not right angles.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A shape has 4 sides and 2 pairs of parallel sides. What is the most specific name for this shape family? : Parallelogram Trapezoid
Solution: Parallelogram. Having two pairs of opposite parallel sides classifies the shape family directly as a parallelogram.

Question Choices: Select the correct option. A square has four right angles and all sides equal. This shape belongs to which of the following families? : Rectangle Rhombus Parallelogram All-above
Hints: It belongs to many shape families due to its symmetric properties.
Solution: All-above. A square fits the definition of a parallelogram (2 pairs of parallel sides), a rectangle (4 right angles), and a rhombus (4 equal sides).

Question Choices: A metalworker crafts a custom window frame with 4 straight sides. The frame is built to have exactly one pair of parallel sides to fit into a sloped roofline. What is this shape called? : Parallelogram Trapezoid Rectangle Rhombus
Solution: Trapezoid. A trapezoid is defined as a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides.
